outcome.technical: Added one helper in plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/_manifest_io.py, shard_file(base, ref, pathmod=os.path) = pathmod.join(base, ref.replace('/', pathmod.sep)), beside shard_rel_path, and routed every site that turns a stub's posix shard ref (or shard_rel_dir) into a path through it: written_twice (the refusal path), assemble/load (read), index_only_in_bodies, stale_stubs, save_sharded targets and its makedirs, and the shard-dir derivation near line 2067. The ref stays posix wherever it is data (split_manifest's stub['shard'], shard_rel_path). On posix the helper is the plain join byte for byte (replace of '/' by '/'), so this repository's plan reads and saves as before. Added case kt4d to tests/test__manifest_io.py (imports ntpath, posixpath): decides the spelling for ntpath ('C:\\plan' + phases/P1.json -> C:\\plan\\phases\\P1.json), posixpath, and this platform's os.path.join exactly; an absolute posix ref under posixpath stays absolute; a real shard-twice refusal from load_manifest and from save_sharded names the platform-joined shard path and, when os.sep is not '/', holds no 'phases/' mixed separator; the paths save_sharded reports equal the platform join. kt3 and kt4b are unchanged: they already build the expected path with os.path.join, so they now pass on Windows by the helper. Gates: sweep-selftests over test__manifest_io.py 207/207; also test__evidence_io, test_merge_manifest, test_close_phase (4 files, 1164 cases ok), test__output_lints and test__deps (493 cases ok); ruff check plugins/audit tools tests .claude/hooks exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- exit 0 (min 3.8). Not run: Windows - the lead's CI dispatch is the evidence for kt3/kt4b on that platform. Dependants: tests/test__manifest_io.py's dependants (sweep-costs.json cost figure, gen-demo-manifest, sweep-selftests, COMPATIBILITY.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, test_gen_demo_manifest.py, SECURITY.md) are unchanged and still correct - only one case added, no name they use changed. _manifest_io.py's importers (guard-release, close-phase, integrate-task, manage-worktrees, _evidence_io, _gate_derive, _invariants, _scoped_commit, and the rest) are still correct: no existing signature changed, one new public name added; their suites (evidence_io, merge_manifest, close_phase) are green. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md section for _manifest_io.py (line ~7326) is not made untrue by this; it may want a mention of shard_file but that file is outside the scope. The recorded sweep cost for test__manifest_io.py (.github/sweep-costs.json) is not updated (outside files). SECOND PASS after probe CI run 45646423969 (still red on Windows only in tests/test__manifest_io.py kt3, tests/test_require_plan.py ur1 and ur7; those are the only FAIL labels in the whole log): the expectations held the posix literal 'phases/P1.json' while the fix names the platform path. Sweep of tests/ for other posix-literal assertions on a shard path in a MESSAGE, decided per site: tests/test__evidence_io.py 11933 and 12006 read `said` already normalised with replace(os.sep,'/') (11933 inline, 12006 in _kv_validate) - correct on both platforms, no change; tests/test__manifest_io.py 2278/2283 likewise normalised; tests/test_run_test_gate.py 14706/14722 and test_audit_task.py 15906 normalised; test__verdict_binding 762/864, test_close_phase 2800, test__invariants 899, test_commit_task_work, test_integrate_task and the rest are repo-relative posix refs built by their own code ('/'.join) or git paths, not through shard_file, and they did not fail on the Windows legs; ur2 (test_require_plan 2612, marker shard) did not fail on Windows, left because I could not show its message goes through shard_file. No other file needs widening.
